wave: The reference image is the character's model sheet. Draw EXACTLY this character: the same terracotta pot body with the same colour, the same bright green seedling, leaf-arms and feet, the same face style, the same proportions. Draw it at EXACTLY the same size and placement as the reference: centred, the tips of the seedling leaves near the top edge of the frame and the feet on the bottom edge. Do NOT shrink the character to make room for anything. POSE: waving hello, clearly and unmistakably. The leaf-arm on the viewer's right is lifted UP into the air above its shoulder: it rises from the side of the pot and its tip points up and outward, HIGHER than the pot's rim, beside the seedling, exactly like a raised hand waving hi. Its tip reaches up to the height of the seedling's stem, well above the rim, in the empty space to the right of the seedling, and it is tilted outward as if mid-wave. It is clearly separate from the pot, not pressed flat against it. The character has exactly two leaf-arms. The other leaf-arm stays relaxed at its side. The eyes are the same large glossy near-black ovals with one white highlight dot each as the reference, looking at the viewer. A wide friendly open smile. Preserve the art style exactly: a smooth glossy 3D cartoon render like a shiny toy, clean simple surfaces with soft studio highlights. NO photographic texture, NO leaf veins, NO clay grain, NO realistic eyes. Cheeks stay flat soft pink circles. Compose the whole character and any prop fully inside the frame. The background must be a single flat uniform pure magenta (hex #FF00FF) filling every pixel that is not the character or its prop. No shadow, no reflection, no gradient, no vignette, no checkerboard, no ground, no text.
